Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek: Enable headset of ASUS B1400CEPE with ALC256

ASUS B1400CEPE laptop's headset audio is not enabled until
ALC256_FIXUP_ASUS_HPE quirk is applied.

Here is the original pin node values:

0x12 0x40000000
0x13 0x411111f0
0x14 0x90170110
0x18 0x411111f0
0x19 0x411111f0
0x1a 0x411111f0
0x1b 0x411111f0
0x1d 0x40461b45
0x1e 0x411111f0
0x21 0x04211020
